name: OTTO – Multi-Objective Recommender System Dataset
description: A large-scale dataset of anonymized e-commerce session events, including clicks, cart additions, and orders, released for the OTTO competition on multi-objective session-based recommendation. This record is loader-only and does not distribute dataset files.
